description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultScopedConfig class, which provides a concrete, immutable implementation of the ScopedConfig interface for managing scoped configurations using the Typesafe Config library. It includes methods for creating instances from different sources, retrieving configuration values, and handling config paths.

classes.name: DefaultScopedConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing ScopedConfig for handling scoped configuration data, providing methods for construction, validation, and value retrieval.

methods.name: dittoScoped
methods.description: Creates a DefaultScopedConfig instance scoped to 'ditto' from a given Config.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new DefaultScopedConfig instance from a Config or ScopedConfig and a config path.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates an empty DefaultScopedConfig instance for a specified config path.
